goal: Ask Astra about the current screen

steps.saw: A tiny (220x44px) dark pill-shaped bar with a purple dot and the word 'Astra' on the left, and a small icon plus the text 'space' inside a lighter pill on the right.
steps.thought: This looks like a menu-bar/dock widget, not a full app window. The right-side pill with an icon and 'space' text looks like a keyboard-shortcut hint, likely meaning Option+Space (a common macOS global-hotkey convention for launcher-style apps).
steps.result: Saw the compact pill UI described above.

steps.thought: Try the shortcut hinted by the pill: Option+Space, expecting it to expand into an input/chat box.

steps.saw: Screenshot identical to step-01 — no visible change.
steps.thought: Maybe the window needs focus/click before a keyboard shortcut is recognized.
Click on the 'Astra' label/logo area to give the window focus.
No visible change from the click either.

steps.saw: Same pill, with the right-side 'space' pill looking like a clickable shortcut hint/button.
steps.thought: Try directly clicking the 'space' hint pill on the right, since it may itself be a button to invoke Astra.
Still no visible change; window may now have focus though.

steps.saw: Same pill (window presumably now focused after the click).
steps.thought: Retry Option+Space now that the window should have focus.
Check whether the shortcut expanded the UI this time.
steps.result: Command failed with NO_WINDOW — the app window could no longer be found/captured.

steps.thought: Perhaps the previous opt-space toggled the window closed; pressing it again might toggle it back open.
Try Escape in case something is in a stuck/modal state blocking the window.
One more attempt with opt-space, in case of a delayed toggle.
Wait a couple seconds in case of an animation/async re-show, then check again.
Final check for window recovery before giving up.
steps.result: NO_WINDOW. Gave up — window never returned.

why: I could infer a plausible next action from the screen alone (the pill showed what looked like an Option+Space shortcut hint, matching a real global hotkey), which is a correct read of the affordance. However, invoking it — whether via the keyboard shortcut or by clicking the hint pill/logo — never produced any visible UI change in the captured window, and at some point after repeated attempts the app's window became uncapturable (NO_WINDOW) and never came back for the rest of the session. I was never able to reach a text-input/chat surface to actually type a question to Astra, so the stated goal (ask Astra a question about the current screen) was not achieved. It's unclear whether the window was closed by one of my own actions (a click or key toggling it shut) or whether it was an unrelated app/session issue, but from a first-time user's perspective the tiny pill gave a shortcut hint that, when followed, led to losing the app window entirely with no visible recovery path.
